name: AGIEval
intro: AGIEval是一个以人为中心的基准测试，旨在评估基础模型在人类水平任务上的通用能力。它通过使用标准化考试（如高考、法学院入学考试和数学竞赛）来评估模型，以反映模型在现实世界场景中的表现。该基准测试揭示了模型的优势和局限性，为提升其通用能力提供了有价值的见解。
metric: 选择题准确率；填空题Exact Match与F1
intro_en: AGIEval is a human-centered benchmark designed to evaluate the general capabilities of foundation models on human-level tasks. It assesses models using standardized exams such as the Gaokao, law school entrance exams, and math competitions to reflect their performance in real-world scenarios. This benchmark reveals the strengths and limitations of models, providing valuable insights for improving their general abilities.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW reviewed against arXiv:2304.06364v2 Sections 3.1-3.3 and 4.2 plus repository commit 84ab72d94318290aad2e4ec820d535a95a1f7552. The diagram treats the paper v1 snapshot of 20 tasks and 8,062 reported questions separately from official repository v1.1, whose 18 multiple-choice plus 2 cloze files contain 7,066 counted records after later corrections. Gaokao and SAT are described only as public online sources because neither the paper nor fixed repository identifies an official release channel; no unsupported normalization stage is shown. Source-specific 5-shot construction and CoT rationale provenance are explicit. For cloze tasks, paper Section 3.3.2 names EM and F1, while experiments and fixed code use exact-match or mathematical equivalence; an implemented F1 parser was not found in the reviewed repository. Human bounds distinguish source-paper results from scaled official exam scores.
